messages.subject: Nawras Power | International Director | Energy Transition, ESG & Stakeholders | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Nawras Power HR Team,

The build-out of Saudi power infrastructure and the transition from development into long-term operations require disciplined engagement across government, communities, contractors and operating teams. This aligns strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial solar and battery-storage platform.

I am seeking Director, Senior Director or Head-level opportunities across ESG, external affairs, stakeholder relations, government relations, strategic partnerships and responsible operations.

I am internationally mobile, available after a 30-day notice period and require employer-supported work authorization. My three-page executive CV is attached for consideration within your growing Saudi organization.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
